rows.question: Who are our top 3 customers by total spend?
rows.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.full_name AS full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS total_spend FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 3
rows.first_attempt_sql:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spend
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 3
